title: Spotify’s latest ‘Wrapped’ covers your entire music history
raw_text:
Spotify is celebrating its 20th anniversary by giving listeners a “fully personalized look at their entire music history.” Starting today, Spotify mobile app users can access a new Wrapped-like experience that features “never-before-shared data” going back to when they first joined the service.
Spotify’s latest ‘Wrapped’ covers your entire music history
The company will include ‘never-before-shared data’ as part of its 20th anniversary celebrations.
The company will include ‘never-before-shared data’ as part of its 20th anniversary celebrations.
The “Spotify 20: Your Party of the Year(s)” experience will allow users to look back on their first day on Spotify, the first song they streamed, their most-listened to artist, and the total number of unique songs listened to since creating their account. Spotify is also putting together an All-Time Top Songs Playlist that includes the top 120 tracks a user has listened to, alongside figures showing how many times they have played each song.
Spotify doesn’t describe this anniversary experience as an official “Wrapped,” but the format is similar to those annual listening throwbacks — it just goes back much further. And like Wrapped, the “Your Party of the Year(s)” history will also come with a shareable custom stat card that’s designed to be sent to friends or posted on social media.
Users can access this new experience by searching for “Spotify 20” or “Party of the Year(s)” within the mobile app, or visiting spotify.com/20 directly on mobile devices. We have asked Spotify if the recap will also be available to desktop users.
